Leave fields empty to follow the theme. An override pins that value, even when a seed changes. Clear it to reconnect to the defaults.

Semantic colour overrides are available for precise control; they stop that colour following its palette. Status colours stay independent of the five seeds. Layout and layering tokens only affect components that consume them.
